(Currently Amended): 1. A system, comprising: a processor node comprising a processor and a network interface; a plurality of memory nodes, wherein each memory node comprises a memory and a network interface; a communication network configured to interconnect said processor node and said plurality of memory nodes via said network interfaces according to a network topology, wherein each of said memory nodes is removed from said processor node by a respective number of network hops according to said network topology; wherein said processor node is configured to: broadcast a memory request message comprising a unique identifier of a given memory request and a requested memory size to a subset of said plurality of memory nodes; send a confirmation message comprising the unique identifier to a particular one of the subset of memory nodes in response to receiving a reservation acknowledgment message from said particular one of the memory nodes; access memory on the particular one of the memory nodes in response to receiving a commit message from the particular one of the memory nodes indicating that the memory has been allocated for the given memory request, wherein the confirmation message further includes a data structure that indicates the status of the memory allocation process.

(Currently Amended): 10. The system of claim 1, wherein each memory node of said subset is removed from said processor node by no more than a given number of network hops; and wherein if no memory node of said subset indicates that it can satisfy the given memory request, the processor node is further configured to increase said given number of network hops and to broadcast the memory request message to a second subset of said plurality of memory nodes, wherein each memory node of said second subset is removed from said processor node by no more than said increased given number of network hops.

(Currently Amended): 12. A method, comprising: a processor node broadcasting a memory request message comprising a unique identifier of a given memory request and a requested memory size to a plurality of memory nodes, wherein said plurality of memory nodes and said processor node are interconnected via a communication network according to a network topology; the processor node sending a confirmation message comprising a unique identifier and a status data structure to a particular one of the plurality of memory nodes in response to receiving a reservation acknowledgment message from said particular one of the plurality of memory nodes; and the processor accessing memory on the particular one of the memory nodes in response to receiving a commit message from the particular one of the memory nodes indicating that the memory has been allocated for the given memory request.
